title: ECB holds rates as inflation moderates
summary: The Governing Council held its key rates and said future decisions would remain data-dependent.

title: New export controls cover advanced chipmaking equipment
summary: The measure covers specified advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment and includes a transition period.

title: Novartis reports quarterly medicine sales
summary: Novartis reported quarterly results and maintained its company guidance.

title: EU adopts new sanctions package
summary: The Council adopted restrictions covering listed entities and selected trade flows.

title: Researchers assess changes in European defence spending
summary: The analysis compares announced spending plans and cautions that budgets and delivered capabilities differ.

title: Shipping disruption raises delivery times
summary: A public monitoring note records longer shipping times on routes affected by security concerns.

title: EMA recommends authorization of a new cancer medicine
summary: EMA's committee recommended authorization for a defined group of patients after reviewing clinical evidence.

title: Trial tests gene therapy for inherited retinal disease
summary: An early human study is evaluating safety and preliminary measures of visual function. Efficacy is not established.

title: Large trial evaluates cardiovascular prevention program
summary: A randomized clinical trial reported fewer cardiovascular events in the intervention group; full limitations are described in the publication.

title: Review examines physical activity and healthy ageing
summary: The review associates regular physical activity with healthier ageing while noting that observational evidence cannot establish every causal pathway.
